notes: Throughput is based on the observed one-step-per-cycle hourly cadence with the merge trigger unverified: each firing marks the previous task DONE and claims the next. Every kit step (about 10 to 30 minutes) fit inside one hour.

If the routine has, or is given, the GitHub 'pull request closed, merged into main' trigger, the next cycle starts as soon as a merge lands, allowing back-to-back cycles and more than one task per hour.
At a usage limit the task goes to RETRY_AFTER_RESET and the next hourly run after the reset picks it up; never pay per use (BUILD_BRIEF.md:274, BUILD_BRIEF.md:509).
The Haiku samples come from tiny rehearsal tasks and understate a real build task; K0 is the closest sample of real work.
A live lease naming a different session always means stop, with no exceptions (D-171).
BUILD_BRIEF.md Appendix A shows cron 7 * * * *; the live routine uses 50 * * * *. Either is hourly; the schedule follows the live routine.
